prs.title: [ROCm][CI] Accept Different But Valid Output for `test_olmoe_tp`
prs.author: micah-wil
prs.body_head:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
We're seeing some failures in `LoRA TP Test (Distributed)` on AMD MI355 CI pipeline https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/5300/steps/canvas?sid=019c8e72-d91a-42ee-8022-a42c57625216&tab=output#019c8e72-da1d-4fc3-95e4-3f73d89abcad/L1235. There are two issues. The first is that sometimes the output includes comments at the end explaining the SQL query output, but once I conditioned the prompt template to tell it to not do that, this issue was resolved. The second issue is that it outputs a different output than the expected one, but it is still valid. I've just included it as a valid response in the test. With this change, I am seeing the following when running `pytest -v -s -x lora/test_olmoe_tp.py`:

```
======================= 6 passed, 17 warnings in 74.97s (0:01:14) ===================
```
